game.name: Bully: Anniversary Edition
game.desc: Bully: Anniversary Edition runs on AArch64 Linux handhelds through the NextOS native Android so-loader. It includes automatic memory and GLES2/GLES3 profiles, optimized asset streaming, positional controller support and an optional editable GPTokeyb fallback. Game files are not included; provide your complete, legally owned ARM64 Android data on first launch.
game.developer: Rockstar New England / War Drum Studios
